# Brand Foundations

## Logo
Use the master logo and approved variations only. Maintain clear space equal to the logo height and avoid distortion.

## Colors
- Flow Train Blue: `#2BAEE4`
- Near Black: `#231F20`
- Dark Purple: '#5A4FCF'(Brand Accent)
---RGB: 90, 79, 207
--HSL: 245°, 57%, 56%

## Typography
- Headings: Inter Bold
- Body: Inter Regular
